mechanism.targets: Explicit --database-url and --operating-database-url; no experimental environment fallback
mechanism.identity: Actual PostgreSQL pg_control_system().system_identifier plus pg_database.oid. Equivalent hostnames/URLs do not establish separation.
mechanism.intended_role: pg_db_role_setting setdatabase=current database OID, setrole=0, setconfig contains matchforge.database_role=experimental. Not a session GUC or name suffix.
mechanism.order: Validate connection settings; read-only operating identity; read-only target identity and persistent role; log credential-free target identity; enable writes on that same target connection; then provider/publication work.
mechanism.launcher: Verify before subprocess; pin resolved hostaddr/port/dbname/user; replace DATABASE_URL and FOOTBALL_DATABASE_URL; remove PG* defaults from child. Reject routing PG* settings, libpq service/options, multihost and incomplete/nested targets.
mechanism.limits: Launcher supplies connection settings to cooperating phase scripts. It is not a sandbox for arbitrary code. Scripts must not reload .env or independently override database settings. Shared registries retain provider-neutral caller-owned connections; supported experimental entrypoints enforce selection.
mechanism.ordinary_operations: Product operational provider sync, admin authorization, provider quota owners, worker publication fences, protected research and parity/cutover gates unchanged.

test_target_markers: Only newly provisioned disposable test targets; deleted with their owned databases by existing harness.
